MYSTIX.Name: Mythic Points
MYSTIX.Hint: A second, GM-awarded pool that can be used for anything Hero Points can do.

Sheet.Label: Mythic Points
Sheet.Tooltip: Mythic Points {value}/{max} — click to add one, right-click to remove.

Dialog.AwardLabel: Points to award (or negative to remove)
Dialog.AwardHint: Awards are added to the actor's current value, clamped to the Mythic Point maximum.
Dialog.SetMaxHint: The pool size for this actor. Set to 0 to hide the widget for them.
Dialog.SkipRefreshHint: Exclude this character from the automatic Mythic Point refreshes (session start and encounter start). Manual awarding and spending are unaffected.

Chat.RerollNoPoints: {actor} has no Mythic Points to spend.
Chat.RerollFailed: MystiX | Reroll failed — Mythic Point refunded.
Chat.RerollTooltipHero: Reroll this check using a Hero Point.

AwardDefaultMax.name: Default Max Mythic Points
AwardDefaultMax.hint: Maximum Mythic Points for characters that haven't had one set individually.

HeroPointsEnabled.name: Hero Points Stay Enabled
HeroPointsEnabled.hint: Keep the regular Hero Point pool visible and usable alongside Mythic Points.

ChatReroll.name: Enable Mythic Reroll Context Menu
ChatReroll.hint: Adds a 'Reroll using a Mythic Point' option to chat message context menus, plus Mythic (and Hero) reroll buttons on check cards.

MythicRerollBonus.name: Mythic Reroll Bonus
MythicRerollBonus.hint: Bonus added to the die when a Mythic Point is spent on a reroll. The standard mythic proficiency bonus is +10; set to 0 for a plain reroll.
MythicRerollBonus.MenuLabel: PF2E | Reroll using a Mythic Point
MythicRerollBonus.MenuLabelBonus: PF2E | Reroll using a Mythic Point (+{bonus})
MythicRerollBonus.TooltipMythic: Spend a Mythic Point to reroll
MythicRerollBonus.TooltipMythicBonus: Spend a Mythic Point to reroll with a +{bonus} bonus.

AutoOpenHud.name: Open Party HUD on World Load
AutoOpenHud.hint: Automatically open the party tracker when the world finishes loading (GM only).

RefreshOnSession.name: Refresh Mythic Points on Session Start
RefreshOnSession.hint: When the world loads, refill every character's Mythic Points to full. Happens at most once per calendar day, so reloading the world doesn't refresh again.

RefreshOnEncounter.name: Refresh Mythic Points on Encounter Start
RefreshOnEncounter.hint: At the start of each combat, refill every character's pool to full — or grant a fixed amount, depending on the refresh style below.

EncounterRefreshStyle.name: Encounter Refresh Style
EncounterRefreshStyle.hint: Refill tops every pool up to full at the start of each combat. Fixed grants a set number of points per encounter, accumulating toward each character's max instead of resetting it.

EncounterGrant.name: Fixed Encounter Grant
EncounterGrant.hint: Mythic Points granted to every character at the start of each combat when the refresh style is 'Fixed grant per encounter'.

Errors.GMOnly: Only the GM can do that.
Errors.NotCharacter: Mythic Points are only available on character sheets.
